headline: Second-best revenue quarter; trading and advisory strong
summary_short: Goldman Sachs earned $5.29B ($17.01 per diluted share, +39% y/y) on net revenues of $18.7B, up 23% y/y, as Global Banking & Markets revenue rose 32% and ROE reached 18.7%.
summary_long: Net revenues rose 23% y/y but fell 8% q/q. Global Banking & Markets grew 32% y/y on record Advisory and record Equities financing; Asset & Wealth Management grew 14% on record management fees; Platform Solutions fell 72% on Apple Card portfolio markdowns. Operating expenses rose 20% y/y on higher transaction-based costs and compensation. The provision was $368M, mainly wholesale loan impairments. Charitable contributions cut EPS by about $1.00. Goldman returned $4.49B to common shareholders; standardized CET1 was 12.4%. No numeric guidance was given.
confidence_notes: Source is the earnings results presentation filed as an exhibit to the 8-K (no separate EX-99.1 text was found by the exhibit resolver). Diluted EPS includes about $1.00 of drag from approximately $450M of charitable contributions to Goldman Sachs Gives. The shard's Yahoo EPS ($17.01) matches the release. CET1 figures are preliminary estimates per the presentation. No forward guidance was stated.

drivers.explanation: Significantly higher revenues in Global Banking & Markets, with record Advisory and record Equities financing; Asset & Wealth Management also rose, while Platform Solutions fell on Apple Card portfolio markdowns.
Significantly higher transaction-based expenses and higher compensation reflecting improved operating performance; charitable contributions to Goldman Sachs Gives were also significantly higher.
Higher net revenues, largely from Global Banking & Markets, outweighed higher operating expenses and provision.
Charitable contributions reduced diluted EPS by approximately $1.00 this quarter.
Primarily reflected impairments related to wholesale loans.
Charitable contributions reduced annualized ROE by approximately 1.1 percentage points.
CEO David Solomon cited clients turning to the firm for advice, execution and financing, resulting in second-highest quarterly net revenues and record year-to-date net revenues.
